hint: Tap pages to select them. To move one, drag it (on a touch screen, press and hold first).
insertEnd: At the end of the document
moveEarlier: Move one step towards the start
moveLater: Move one step towards the end

dnd.instructions: Press Space to pick up the page, the arrow keys to move it, Space to drop it, Escape to cancel.

emptyText: No pages are left. Undo the last action, or insert pages.

help.select: The large number is the new position; “p. 5” recalls the original page.
help.move: Dragging a selected page moves the whole selection.
help.more: The ⋮ button on a page gathers all its actions, no dragging needed.
help.insert: “Insert” adds after the last selected page, otherwise at the end. A blank page takes the size of its neighbour.
help.keys: Keyboard: Ctrl+Z undoes, Ctrl+Shift+Z or Ctrl+Y redoes, Delete removes the selection.

empty: No pages are left to put in the PDF.
unchanged: No changes: the PDF will be identical to the original.
summary_one: The new PDF will have {{count}} page.
summary_other: The new PDF will have {{count}} pages.
